cycles.clock_note: OPS DEFECT (self-caught 06:31): the session was estimating elapsed ET from the number of tool calls rather than reading the clock, and had drifted ~45 min AHEAD of real time -- it believed it was 07:16 when it was 06:30. Causally harmless here (the ranker only reads bars that exist, and --as-of 06:44 simply admitted every cached bar), but it mislabels the ledger and would have been dangerous near the 14:30 entry cutoff and the 14:57 flatten. Corrected rule for the rest of the session: read the clock immediately before any --as-of, arming, or cutoff decision, never estimate it. This is the CLOCK RULE's cousin -- TZ env is broken AND elapsed time cannot be eyeballed.
